title: Value Imprint: A Technique for Auditing the Human Values Embedded in RLHF Datasets

bias_targets.methodology: Developing a 7-category taxonomy of human values (e.g., Information Seeking, Wisdom/Knowledge, Duty & Accountability, Justice & Rights), qualitatively annotating a ground truth dataset, and training a RoBERTa classifier to audit and measure the distributional skew and underrepresentation of these values across three large-scale RLHF datasets (Anthropic/hh-rlhf, OpenAI WebGPT Comparisons, and Alpaca GPT-4-LLM).
